commit.message:
fix: preserve fidelity when mapping external VLM output (Chandra, dots, MinerU) (#4470)

* fix: improve Chandra OCR parsing and preserve document structure

Signed-off-by: Christoph Auer <cau@zurich.ibm.com>

* fix: support Chandra OCR reasoning responses

Signed-off-by: Christoph Auer <cau@zurich.ibm.com>

* fix: avoid duplicate Chandra checkbox markers

Signed-off-by: Christoph Auer <cau@zurich.ibm.com>

* Fix double location tags

Signed-off-by: Christoph Auer <cau@zurich.ibm.com>

* More hardening for chandra OCR to docling parsing

Signed-off-by: Christoph Auer <cau@zurich.ibm.com>

* handle bare-text siblings of images

Signed-off-by: Christoph Auer <cau@zurich.ibm.com>

* fix: preserve external VLM mapping fidelity

Signed-off-by: Christoph Auer <cau@zurich.ibm.com>

* fix: associate native MinerU and dots captions with adjacent containers

Signed-off-by: Christoph Auer <cau@zurich.ibm.com>

* fix: treat Chandra equation blocks with prose as text

A Chandra Equation-Block that mixes prose and inline math becomes text with
inline formula runs; math with only punctuation around it stays one formula.

---------

Signed-off-by: Christoph Auer <cau@zurich.ibm.com>
